text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s07.e08","problem":"Hero art leaves a strip on the right: the heatmap shows a blue-masked image ending at x=344 and a mismatched red band from x=344 to 381. The real art spans the full card width and has a different crop.","fix":"Draw assets/s07.e08.art.png at its own rect (x29, y102.9, w315, h353.4). Behind it, fill the rest of the frame (x344 to 381) with the real art's edge colors (maroon #8a4a5a at top, blue #2f6a8a in the middle) so no black strip shows. Give the frame a 1px #b08a95 border with a 4px radius."},{"element_id":"s08.e08","problem":"Hero art leaves a mismatched strip on the right (x~355-381). The mock's crop differs from the real art.","fix":"Draw assets/s08.e08.art.png at its own rect (x29, y102.9, w322.6, h353.4). Fill the remaining frame area to x381 with a dark blue (#1d3a66) background, and keep the 1px light border with a 4px radius."},{"element_id":"s07.e45","problem":"The Aaditya avatar at the 'PLAYING AS' row is blurry and its crop is slightly off; the heatmap shows a blue block with a shifted edge.","fix":"Draw assets/s07.e45.art.png exactly at x30.1, y757.8, w57.1, h49.4, with no extra scaling or rounding."},{"element_id":"s07.e14","problem":"The like count '2' next to the heart renders as a tiny glyph that looks like '8'. The real one is a bold purple digit about 10x20px.","fix":"Set the count text to '2' with font-size 18px, weight 500, color #b79cf0, line-height 20px, at x335, y474, with no letter-spacing. Do the same on s08 for '1'."},{"element_id":"s02.e43","problem":"The card art is cropped and shifted compared with the real art. The first card shows the lanterns and towers higher, and the second card is too dark and too far zoomed.","fix":"Draw assets/s02.e43.art.png at x24, y361.2, w168.7, h152.3. Draw assets/s02.e47.art.png at x218.7, y361.2, w168.7, h152.3. Use object-fit:fill with no extra transforms, and keep the dark card background behind them."},{"element_id":"s02.e15","problem":"The filter button icon is slightly off. The heatmap shows red inside the button.","fix":"Draw assets/s02.e15.png at x363.8, y117, w32, h32 and assets/s02.e16.png at x369.9, y123, w19.4, h19.4, instead of a CSS-drawn icon."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The bottom-nav center icon is a cat-head outline. The real one is a spiral logo in gray-white. The stat badges use a speech-bubble icon where the real ones show a stacked-bubbles icon plus a document icon. The chip emoji differ.","fix":"Replace the center nav icon with a filled swirl/spiral glyph, about 30px, color #c9c9d0. Change the badge icons to two overlapping bubbles (messages) and a page icon (tokens). Make the badge text 13px, weight 500, with 4px between the icon and the text. Use the Apple-style emoji (👨, ⛓, 👩‍🦰, 📚, 📺, 👫) at 11px."},{"element_id":"s07","problem":"All text is red in the heatmap, with glyphs about 1px off. The heading font is lighter than the real one, the badge '14 31' icons are wrong, and the chips' emoji are drawn in a different style.","fix":"Shift the body text 1px lower. Use a slightly wider geometric font for the title (Kitsunami) at 20px with letter-spacing 0.5px. In the read-count badge, use an open-book icon for 14 and a stacked-bubbles icon for 31, and widen the number text to fit. Use the real emoji set in the tag chips."},{"element_id":"s08","problem":"The description's first line has a 📊 emoji drawn as a plain chart with extra space; the real one is the 🏙 city emoji, '[🏙️Fragment Update!]' with no space. The tag emoji also differ in style.","fix":"Change the first line to '[🏙️Fragment Update!]' (no space after the emoji). Use the standard emoji for 👨 👩‍🦰 🎮 👫 🎲 👤 in the tag chips, at 11px."},{"element_id":"s13","problem":"The text and radio buttons sit about 1px above the real positions. For example 'Filters' is at y95 in both, but 'Sort by' is at 140 instead of 141 and the radios are at 181 instead of 182. The Messages and Tokens dropdowns have a thin border instead of the thicker one.","fix":"Shift every element below 'Filters' down 1px. Set the dropdown borders to 2px solid #6b6d73. Draw the three images assets/s13.e90.png, s13.e91.png and s13.e92.png at their rects at the bottom (y774.9), plus assets/s13.e03.png at x15.6, y62.5, w325.3, h42.7."}],"summary":"All elements are placed and taps work, so the remaining gap is image fidelity and typography. The most valuable changes are filling the hero art on s07 and s08 to the full card width, drawing the listed pictures at their own rects (s07.e45, s02 art and button icons, s13 images), and fixing the like-count digit and the nav and badge icons. After that, adjust the 1px text offsets and the emoji styles."}
